of LIXIL GROUP established in 2018, brings LIXIL’s global expertise in windows and doors to the Indian market. Our mission is to offer a diverse selection of top-quality products, blending cutting-edge technology, elegance, and comfort. As a leading brand, TOSTEM provides a comprehensive range of window and door solutions. Celebrated worldwide for its aluminum windows, entrance doors, partition doors, hanging doors etc., TOSTEM masterfully balances innovation with aesthetics, security and service. Our commitment to form and function ensures that we deliver unparalleled products that meet global standards. TOSTEM product range is entirely factory-made, with assembly and installation being done at the site. This helps in maintaining global standards,- ensures timely deliveries and provides an assured service to the customer. TOSTEM has introduced innovative Japanese expertise to the Indian market, revolutionizing end-to-end window and door solutions to be easy, enjoyable, and truly valuable for consumers. At our TOSTEM Manesar manufacturing unit, we produce select series such as WE PLUS, WE 70 and EZ, ensuring quick delivery. Products manufactured here are dispatched within 21 days, adhering to the same high standards. The products are technically very advanced and carry full test certification which is an edge over the competition. Know more about TOSTEM TOSTEM PRODUCTION FACILITY The company imports products from one of the largest production facilities in the world – TOSTEM Thai Co. Ltd. (TTC) facility in Thailand, which is an integrated facility dedicated to the manufacturing of aluminum windows. Starting from the designing of new products, to the casting of alloy, extrusion, surface treatment, coating & fabrication – all is carried out in-house at TTC. Once the window production is completed at the TTC facility, these pre-engineered windows are transported to India, directly to the site. This ensures last-mile quality since these pre-engineered windows are supplied in a box, making assembly and installation at site quick and easy for residential as well as commercial projects. TOSTEM INDIA also has a local manufacturing unit in Manesar, India to cater the customized needs of its retail customers from India, which ensures consistency and reliability in terms of quality as per global standards, while maintaining short delivery timeframes for the retail business. TOSTEM INDIA has developed a nation-wide network of Channel Partners who are the primary sales and service arm of the Company. Brand building, Business development, Training and Supply chain support are provided by TOSTEM INDIA. TOSTEM PRODUCTS TOSTEM focuses on the development, manufacturing, and marketing of a diverse array of aluminum doors and windows. Our extensive product portfolio enables us to offer comprehensive lifestyle solutions that are flexible, integrated, and tailored to meet consumer needs, ensuring daily satisfaction. TOSTEM’s dedication to providing comfort to customers worldwide drives us to continually refine our products. Leveraging over half a century of engineering expertise and commitment to quality, we aim to design aluminum windows that seamlessly blend functionality with everyday comfort for all. As the leading Japanese brand for global housing and building materials, TOSTEM stands apart as a one that deeply understands the needs of people coming from different countries and climates. Japanese products like cars, have won the confidence of customers in India for very high reliability, finish, and performance. With TOSTEM, customers will enjoy similar benefits and will appreciate owning a Japanese product. TOSTEM products are lean in design and lean in cost. This benefit comes from the excellence of design, high volume manufacturing, and cost control from ingot to fabricated window. 50 Years’ Performance History in different weather conditions! Similar to Japan where the climate is both cold and cyclonic, India also faces extreme weather variations: from dry cold to hot humid, from minimal rains to severe cyclonic conditions, and therefore TOSTEM windows are designed to make windows safe against air and water ingress. TOSTEM mass manufacturing! TOSTEM is one of the first, large scale manufacturers of aluminum windows in the world. The TOSTEM method of manufacturing uses dedicated machines (punch & die set) for every operation, as used in mass manufacturing, which helps in driving better process control and higher production output rates. It is also easier to exercise quality control as there is a dedicated cell for each window design. High precision process! The punch system of manufacturing followed by TOSTEM is very accurate. An anodizing finish is preferred as it has a uniform thickness of 20 microns. Powder coating is also used, but is more difficult in production, as thickness usually varies between 60-120 microns. Since manufacturing tolerances are so close – manufacturing accuracy and flatness are also very high, which makes for great ease during glazing and assembly. Life cycle testing in accredited test lab! The test lab in Japan is accredited by the Japanese Government. The factory in Thailand has the largest testing facility for wind pressure, air tightness, water tightness, material composition, sound isolation, thermal insulation, light & UV resistance, profile and anodizing life test against both JIS and ASTM Standards. Rollers are tested for 200,000 operations which is many times more than lifetime usage of the product. Ease of operation! Windows are intended to be opened and closed many times a day. A key aspect of the design is that effort should be minimal so that even a child can safely open the window. For instance, the effort required to open or close a 2-track / 4-panel WE Plus Door of 4200 mm width and 2400 mm height with single glass is under 50 N (5 Kgs). The effort is so less that it does not require any mechanical assistance or automation. Ease of storage & transportation! The sash and frame are packed in separate boxes. Gaskets are supplied in roll form. The entire bundle is very compact which reduces transportation cost and transit damages. Space required for storage at the site is much less which reduces the chances of theft. Lead and lift requirements are much simplified. Sustainable materials & fire safety Aluminum is 100% recyclable and has a higher resale value as compared to other window materials. It is also environment friendly, fire-safe, and does not release toxic fumes in event of a fire. The life of aluminum windows is much longer. System Windows We have re-imagined the way a window is manufactured, packed and shipped to the site and introduced the concept of Pre-Engineered System Windows, where the windows are shipped in small boxes to the site. Design Performance & Actual Performance is the same! Since the entire window is manufactured at the factory, there is no deviation from design performance. Control Till End Stage, Site Work Becomes Low Skill! Work at the site usually poses more problems, due to worker skill levels and difficulty in exercising process control. The better solution followed by TOSTEM is to: Reduce work content on site. Simplify work so that it can be done by semi-skilled or low skill workers (TOSTEM assembly requires only one primary tool – screwdriver). Use of visual instructions so that training requirements is reduced. No Fabricator Dependence! TOSTEM is a window manufacturer and not a fabricator or system supplier. The entire accountability for timely supplies and the quality of the product is with TOSTEM. TOSTEM works with trained installers who undertake glazing, assembly, and installation of windows. TOSTEM will always ensure that the project is completed within the time period promised. Assurance and Testing Quality Assurance As Per Global Standards Every country has its own set of standards to define the safety standard of the products to be used in housing projects. In India, ASTM (American Standards for Testing and Materials) and BS (British standards) are commonly used standards of testing by the home builders and engineers. JIS (Japanese Industrial Standards) which are followed in Japan not new to India, since most Japanese automobile companies use JIS standards. JIS in windows systems is more relevant as the cyclonic weather of Japan is similar to that of India and JIS testing process very closely mimics the natural forces. TOSTEM has a product which is rated as per JIS standards as well as products which are rated as per ASTM Standards. Though both the Standards are equally safe – ASTM testing gives us a more rigid and often over-engineered product, which may add bulk to the resultant window design . While JIS on the other hand, gives us a product that can sustain fatigue, is lean, and performance-friendly. All TOSTEM windows are tested as per any of the above standards. We cross-check all our product offerings and theoretical calculations with the actual test results which are done at the TOSTEM product test centers in Japan/Thailand. TOSTEM has a state-of-the-art testing facility for Doors and Windows in TOSTEM Thailand Facility. As a part of a transparent business policy, we encourage our customers to visit both the manufacturing facility as well as the testing facility. We feel that this visit is an important aspect of the product selection process for all big projects as the customer gets confident that the windows which will be delivered to the project are truly world-class. Dedicated Teams for understanding project requirements TOSTEM India has a dedicated team of engineers at the Manesar plant who calculate the Wind-Load, weather extremities, or any special client’s requirements. All the quality checks and testing calculations are done considering National Building Code . The team considers factors like the location of the project, size, and shape of the building, the height at which the window will be installed, etc. for every project before we propose the window solutions. Additionally, we are supported by a team of engineers at TOSTEM Thailand who help us chose the best window solution for different projects. TOSTEM Testing Process Window performance parameters like wind-load capacity are measured using standard engineering procedures and formulas, as explained above. However, certain performance parameters like water tightness, airtightness, and sound insulation haze to be measured by putting a full-size window in a test structure and applying relevant forces. This is because: these performances can be greatly improved if we use additional accessories like air sealing gaskets and drainage valve, etc. To assure the performance of TOSTEM products on these parameters, we follow a physical laboratory testing procedure inside our product test centers in Thailand and Japan. TOSTEM product test center has a full-size window mounted on a fixed structure inside the laboratory which is capable to simulate various conditions required for the testing of the window. For wind loads, a pressure generator, mostly a large fan attached to a very powerful engine, is used to create positive as well as negative wind pressure. Additionally, to test the water tightness in the test center, a constant spray of water is showered on the window to simulate the rainfall, along with the wind. For an airtightness test, the sample is mounted on the test rig which is perfectly sealed. From the outside, constant pressure is generated and on the inside, the rig is connected to an anemometer which helps to calculate the volume of air leaked. In a similar test chamber, but modified to control echoes, a controlled sound is created on the outside, and a level of sound is measured on the inside and recorded. This gives the sound insulation level of the window. For testing TOSTEM product’s life, tests like endurance testing and accelerated weathering test under various conditions are done on the product to calculate the expected life expectancy of the product. Soundproof Doors and Windows Become the proud owner of a soundproof and noise-free home with TOSTEM Aluminium Doors and windows. Featuring JIS-certified soundproofing efficiency, TOSTEM aluminium doors act as the perfect barrier between your home and external noises. Designed to block all potential entryways for noise leakage, our aluminium doors transform your home into a noise-free zone of sheer comfort and delight. Transform your homes and commercial spaces into the noise-free haven it has the potential to be. Get your hands on our aluminium soundproof door and window designs for home and office settings. Product Features TOSTEM aluminium doors and windows are JIS-tested for soundproofing and noise insulation. 25db Noise Insulation with single glass Impeccable Sealing with EPDM & Nano Gaskets 5 mm silicon sealant at all corners Glass thickness upto 31.4 mm Enquire Now Download Brochure Download Test Report Japanese Technology 50 years of performance history Pre Engineered System Perform exactly as designed Tested as per Global Standards Designed and tested as per JIS standards for higher sound insulation performance Soundproof Doors And Windows: Photo Gallery prev next What Makes TOSTEM Aluminium Doors & Windows Soundproof EPDM Gaskets at Interlocks What gives our aluminium doors and windows that much-desired soundproofing efficiency is the use of EPDM gaskets between two sashes and outer frames. Conventionally used in car doors, EPDM gaskets feature impeccable airtightness. Its usage in our aluminium doors and windows makes sound insulation a guarantee with our products. Impeccable Overlap Sealing The spaces where different door and window parts may overlap are potential entry points for noise and sound disturbances. To ensure that external forces do not hinder your home’s inner sanctum and peace, we ensure proper sealing between the profiles and sashes from all sides of the doors and windows. JIS-Tested Sound Insulation The soundproofing of our doors and windows can be attested by competitive global standards. Our doors and windows are tested for sound performance in a JIS controlled environment. Having passed the JIS sound inspection test with flying colours, we can confidently say that our products demonstrate excellent soundproofing efficiency. Silicone Sealants At Corners Silicone sealant is a liquid metal that is often used in automobiles to block dust and repel sound. At TOSTEM, we use 5 mm thick silicone sealants at all corners to prevent sound leakage. The use of these sealants in our doors and windows ensure air-tightness and better sealing, thus providing an extra layer of protection from sound disturbances. Nano Gaskets: Nano gaskets are micro-sized gaskets that are designed to ensure secure sealing and sound insulation. Parts of a door and window, especially the joints are difficult to seal. Tightness of screws will not prevent sound leakage completely. By using nano gaskets at profile interlock, TOSTEM secures even the tiniest of gaps against disturbing sound elements. Thick Glass Panels: Redefining the concept of soundproofing, the glass panels of our aluminium doors and windows are designed for noise insulation. Our aluminium products feature a glass thickness of up to 31.5 mm and offer JIS-tested noise insulation of 25 DB, which is the sound equivalent of a whisper. To enjoy the goodness of a hassle-free purchase and on-time delivery - browse through our products and purchase them now! 4 Flexible Soundproof Door Price Pricing our products considerately is what we do best at TOSTEM INDIA. We offer the most reasonable and accessible soundproof door prices to ensure that our doors and windows are within the arm’s reach of all contemporary homeowners. TOSTEM soundproof aluminium doors use EPDM gaskets, nano gaskets, silicone sealants, thick glass panels (up to 31.5 mm), and JIS-tested sound insulation technology to ensure superior noise reduction. How much noise can TOSTEM soundproof windows block? TOSTEM noise reduction windows significantly reduce noise, cutting it by up to 25 dB with 6mm glass, which is almost equivalent to whisper-quiet! For even greater peace, thicker glass options are available, enhancing insulation and creating a truly tranquil home environment. Are TOSTEM soundproof doors and windows suitable for homes near busy roads? Yes. For those battling constant disruptions, especially needing soundproof windows for traffic noise, TOSTEM offers a solution. Their doors and windows, designed with strong EPDM gaskets and robust glass, are highly effective. If you're seeking doors for noisy areas, particularly homes near busy highways or city centers, these products significantly reduce unwanted sound. What is the difference between soundproof and regular aluminium windows? Unlike regular windows, TOSTEM’s aluminium window soundproofing feature advanced sealing (EPDM gaskets, silicone sealants) and JIS-tested noise insulation, blocking significantly more sound. How durable are TOSTEM soundproof doors and windows? If you need durable soundproof doors that stand the test of time, look no further. TOSTEM products, crafted with advanced Japanese technology and rigorous JIS and ASTM testing, deliver both impressive soundproofing and exceptional durability. Can TOSTEM windows help with both soundproofing and weather insulation? Yes, TOSTEM weatherproof soundproof windows offer sound insulation, airtightness, and water resistance, thanks to features like nano gaskets and one-way drainage valves. What glass thickness is best for soundproofing with TOSTEM products? TOSTEM offers the best glass for soundroof windows with panels up to 31.5 mm thick, providing JIS-tested noise insulation of 25 dB, ideal for maximum sound reduction. How do I install TOSTEM soundproof doors and windows? If you wish to install soundproof windows, TOSTEM products are factory-made and installed on-site by professionals to ensure perfect sealing and soundproofing performance. Are TOSTEM soundproof doors and windows customisable? Yes, TOSTEM offers a variety of custom soundproof windows in designs, sizes, and colors to suit homes and offices while maintaining soundproofing quality. Testimonials Reach Us TOSTEM Offices Find a TOSTEM Studio System Aluminum Windows Home / System Aluminum Windows System Aluminum Windows are becoming highly popular in India due to longer life, greater reliability and quality assurance. Aluminum is also the dominant material for residential windows in neighboring countries like, Singapore, Thailand, Dubai and Middle East where the climatic conditions are similar. In these markets aluminum is seen as a premium window material. Interior designers in home building industry preferred Aluminum as the most reliable material for windows. Aluminum is being considered as an excellent option for modern home design and décor, as Aluminum windows are low maintenance, beautiful and durable. Contemporary designs & slim frames! By its very nature, metal windows are both slim and strong. It is much easier to fix and operate hardware (metal to metal). Aluminum windows commonly do not require additional steel reinforcing, which is compulsory with other materials. The reinforcing can only be inserted in middle section leaving the corners very weak. Recent developments in ‘Aluminum Minimal Frames’ distributes wind-load across the whole length of the frame. The frame in ‘TOSTEM – GRANTS’ can also be flushed, to produce an attractivevisage of glass. This system is very well suited for high rise buildings and offers a versatilerange of design options Sustainable and Safe! Aluminum is 100% recyclable and has higher resale value as compared to other window materials. It is also environment friendly, fire safe and does not release toxic fumes in event of fire. The life of Aluminum windows is much longer. Driving Experience Pre Engineered System Windows Planning a System Window E-Catalogue Frequently Asked Questions What are System Aluminum Windows? System Aluminum Windows are factory-engineered, precision-tested window solutions where every component like frames, seals, hardware, and glass is designed to work together as a complete system. Unlike conventional fabricated windows, system windows are pre-tested for wind pressure, air infiltration, and water resistance, ensuring consistent performance and longer life. What is the difference between system aluminum windows and regular aluminum windows? Regular aluminum windows are assembled on-site using basic profiles, often without performance testing. System aluminum windows are factory-engineered with precision-fitted components, certified under global standards for air, water, and structural performance. They offer better insulation, tighter seals, smoother operation, and significantly longer durability. How long do aluminum windows last? Aluminum window frames have a very long lifespan — you can expect them to last between 40–60 years if installed correctly. TOSTEM system aluminum windows are built to international standards and engineered to withstand India’s extreme weather conditions, including monsoons, coastal humidity, and intense heat. Are aluminum windows suitable for Indian weather conditions? Yes. Aluminum windows are capable of withstanding extreme climatic conditions such as rain, wind, dust, and heat. They are also designed to be UV and termite-resistant, maintaining a clean and hygienic environment that requires minimal maintenance. This makes them ideal across India’s diverse climates from coastal cities to hot and dry interiors. Are system aluminum windows energy efficient? Modern system aluminum windows with thermal break technology significantly reduce heat transfer between indoor and outdoor spaces. When paired with double or triple glazing and low-E glass, they can be highly efficient. This helps reduce air-conditioning costs in Indian homes. Do aluminum windows require maintenance? Aluminum windows require minimal maintenance. Regular cleaning and occasional lubrication of moving parts are typically all that’s needed to keep them in top condition. A mild detergent and water solution with a soft cloth is all that’s required for cleaning. They do not need repainting, polishing, or chemical treatments. Are aluminum windows recyclable and eco-friendly? Yes. Aluminum is 100% recyclable without losing quality, making it a great choice for environmentally conscious homeowners. It also does not release toxic fumes in the event of fire, making it a safe and sustainable choice for modern homes. What are the different types of system aluminum windows available? System aluminum windows are available in multiple configurations including sliding windows, casement windows, tilt-and-turn windows, fixed windows, and minimal frame systems. TOSTEM offers series like GRANTS, ATIS, We Plus, and We 70, each designed for different architectural styles and performance needs. Can aluminum windows be customized in color and finish? Yes. Aluminum frames are available in any RAL color through a process called powder coating. You can also choose dual colors — a different shade on the outside versus the inside — allowing you to match the frame perfectly with your property and décor. What is the price of system aluminum windows in India? The price per sq. ft. varies depending on the type, features, and level of customization. Factors include frame series, glass type (single, double, or triple glazed), thermal insulation, and hardware. TOSTEM offers transparent, value-driven pricing across its product range. Contact TOSTEM India for a quote tailored to your project. Behaviour LIXIL was founded over 100 years back, when its predecessors combined Japanese craftsmanship of design and color, with the properties of clay to produce one of Japan’s first ceramic tiles for homes. Keeping the same spirit over the years, LIXIL has created products that have redefined the spaces we call home. Architects and designers have played a key role throughout LIXIL’s rich history, integrating functionality with refined aesthetics. This has been the foundation of what we call our Living Culture – a way in which we ensure that our products are always relevant to people, our lifestyles, and the times in which we live. Living Culture embodies LIXIL’s passion to be the Link to Good Living. The spirit of Living Culture will continue to be at the core of every product we make and the service we provide, around the world, and for generations to come. LIXIL Core Philosophy The Group’s superior products and services contribute to improving people’s comfort and lifestyles. MAKE BETTER HOMES A REALITY FOR EVERYONE, EVERYWHERE LIXIL Behaviors The three LIXIL Behaviors provide a unified way of working for all LIXIL employees, helping to make LIXIL a purpose-driven entrepreneurial company for sustainable growth. Studio FAQs Home / FAQs Frequently Asked Questions --> Aluminium Doors Why Should I Install Aluminium door Frames in offices/home? You should install aluminium door frames in your homes and office spaces because of the following reasons: Aluminium doors come in different design options – thus helping you transform your home and office spaces according to your target theme and preference. Aluminium door pricesare, on average, more affordable than wooden doors. Aluminium door design offers durability, meaning minimal expenditure on maintenance and upkeep. When looked at from this perspective, aluminium doors are cost-efficient too. Aluminium glass door designs are easy to clean and maintain, requiring as little as four to five times a year. You have to clean the glass panes, and you’re good to go. How much does an aluminium door cost? Aluminium door prices can vary from company to company based on many factors such as: The reputation of the company : The more recognized the door manufacturing company, the costlier their aluminium frame doors will be. Quality Standards : The quality standards upheld in the manufacturing process of the aluminium door design. Customisations : Based on your unique door customisation requests, the cost of an aluminium frame door can go up significantly. Manufacturing Process : TOSTEM Doors are manufactured in the world’s largest aluminium door and window manufacturing unit based out of Thailand. As the doors are designed, manufactured, and installed by a highly professional and skilled team, there is no deviation in product delivery and performance as was promised at the time of purchase. Aluminium door price per sqft cost : The aluminium door with glass price can also vary based on your total door size requirement. The measurement for each square ft will dictate how expensive your door will be. Get in touch with us at tostemsales.lws@lixil.com to get a quote on our premium aluminium door designs. We would like to hear from you. How to install aluminium doors? The installation of aluminium doors will be undertaken by skilled professionals who are most likely hired by the door manufacturing company. When you make a purchase, a company will send over an employee to fit the aluminium frame door in your home’s desired space. Before you make a purchase, it is ideal that you give the measurements of the door to the company and choose an aluminium door design of the correct size ratio. If you prefer the helping hands of trained professionals, you can request with the door manufacturing What are the Benefits of Aluminium Doors? Doors not only complete the look of any space, but they also offer a seamless connection between the glorious outdoors and the cosy indoors, ushering in ample natural light and facilitating proper air circulation. Check out the benefits of aluminium french doors mentioned below: Stability and Strength Endurance Energy-efficiency Ease in Maintenance Noise insulation Air and water tightness Why is TOSTEM INDIA Known as the Leading Door Manufacturer in India? TOSTEM INDIA aluminium windows come in various designs and can be installed in various combinations of frames. Available in single and multi-sash designs, these windows have a universal appeal and are installed by experienced professionals. These windows are available in myriad colours so that they complement the class and elegance of both residential and commercial interiors. More importantly, TOSTEM windows are delivered to you in boxes, where 90% of the work gets done in the factory. This approach makes the installation more seamless and minimises third-party intervention. Also, TOSTEM spearheads as one of the leading innovators in improving doors and windows aesthetics and functionality. For instance, TEXGUARD coating ensures that the products do not lose their colour and lustre for at least 40 years. The nano and rubber gaskets ensure proper air tightness. In addition, the inclusion of EPDM gaskets, primarily found in automobile doors, provide proper noise insulation. What are Aluminium Glass Doors? Engineered to surpass global standards set by JIS, ASTM, and BS, the aluminium glass doors guarantee steadfast performance even in the face of extreme weather conditions and temperature fluctuations. Crafted with precision and tested for optimal functionality, the aluminium glass doors offer insulation against noise, wind, air, water, and sound, ensuring a serene and comfortable living experience for homeowners across diverse geographical regions. The distinctive feature of our doors lies in their pre-engineered design, streamlining production at the factory to ensure consistent quality regardless of volume.With a versatile range of low-rise and high-rise options, TOSTEM’s luxury aluminium doors empower you to transform your space into a haven of magnificence and sophistication. What are Aluminium Frame Doors? The TOSTEM Aluminium Frame Door is the epitome of modern architectural beauty, designed to infuse elegance and durability into any space. Crafted from high-quality aluminium, it stands as a point of strength and longevity, ensuring your home or office remains secure while offering a sleek, contemporary look.The door’s design maximises natural light, enriching indoor spaces with a bright, airy feel. Perfect for those seeking a blend of sophistication, functionality, and customisation, this door transforms living spaces into havens of style and comfort. Enhanced with anodised and TEXGUARD coatings, the doors boast exceptional resistance to heat, sunlight, and water, ensuring longevity and durability. Aluminium Windows What are the benefits of choosing aluminium windows? Aluminium windows are strong, low-maintenance, and weather-resistant. Aluminium windows are durable, low-maintenance, and weather-resistant. TOSTEM India offers stylish, long-lasting options with TEXGUARD coating for rust protection and insulation to keep your home comfortable for years. How much do aluminium windows cost in India? Aluminium window prices vary by quality, features, and durability. Premium brands like TOSTEM may cost more but offer long-lasting value. What types of aluminium window designs are available? TOSTEM India offers a range of aluminium window designs like sliding, casement, fixed, and awning. Each style is customisable to match both modern and traditional homes, blending looks with functionality. Are aluminium windows energy-efficient? Yes, aluminium windows are energy efficient. TOSTEM India uses insulation materials for effective heat prevention and helps to maintain indoor comfort. How do aluminium windows compare to uPVC or wooden windows? Aluminium windows are stronger than uPVC and more durable than wood. TOSTEM India combines this strength with sleek, low-maintenance designs for larger views, lasting performance, and a premium finish. Can aluminium windows reduce noise? Yes, aluminium windows can reduce noise. TOSTEM India’s windows are available with double or triple glazing, combined with insulation materials that reduce outside noise, making them ideal for urban homes. How long do aluminium windows last? TOSTEM India’s aluminium windows are designed with TEXGUARD coating that offers long-lasting protection and scratch resistance for up to 40 years. Are your aluminium windows customisable? Yes, you can customise the size, colour, finish, and glass type. Whether you prefer a minimalist design or a bold statement, TOSTEM India engineers windows that perfectly complement your space. How do I maintain aluminium windows? Regular cleaning is the simplest way to maintain aluminium windows. Thanks to the protective TEXGUARD coating, there’s no need for polishing or repainting, keeping your windows looking new with minimal effort for up to 40 years. Why choose Tostem India for aluminium windows? TOSTEM India offers smart, reliable solutions for your home with the help of Japanese engineering and pre-designed window systems. Our windows come with advanced coatings, strong anodised frames, and built-in sound insulation. Steel Entrance Doors What makes TOSTEM steel entrance doors different from other brands? TOSTEM steel entrance doors are made using smart Japanese technology. They have strong steel panels on the outside and insulation inside, which makes them very durable, weatherproof, and safe from termites. The doors have a special TEXGUARD coating that keeps them shiny for a long time and makes them easy to clean. They are made with high-quality standards (ASTM and JIS certified). What makes them special? They have: Triple safety locks shaped like a sickle Digital locking system Built-in air vents to let fresh air in Anti-pinch design for extra safety Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors energy-efficient? Yes, TOSTEM steel main doors help keep your home cool in summer and warm in winter. Thanks to the insulated steel layers, they stop outside heat or cold from getting in. This helps lower electricity bills and makes them a great choice for homes that want to save energy. How durable are TOSTEM steel entrance doors? With optimum care, TOSTEM steel entrance doors can last for years. Their strong construction, corrosion-resistant materials, and anodised TEXGUARD coating ensure long-term performance, even in harsh weather conditions like rain, heat, and humidity. What safety features do TOSTEM steel entrance doors offer? TOSTEM doors are designed with advanced safety features, including steel panels, concealed hinges, hook locks, digital handles, and triple sickle-shaped latches. The Giesta double lock system and removable thumb-turn enhance security, protecting against break-ins and blunt forces. Furthermore, their inbuilt airflow system with grill and mesh, offers added security and a channel for ventilation at the same time. Can TOSTEM steel entrance doors withstand extreme weather conditions? Yes, TOSTEM steel main doors are tested to global standards (ASTM and JIS) and engineered to resist harsh weather, including heavy rain, heat, and humidity. The insulated structure and TEXGUARD coating ensure resilience and prevent heat transmission. What design options are available for TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM steel entrance doors come under the GIESTA series, which offers four design sub-series: P Series – Simple design D Series – Modern design G Series – Glass design A Series – Airflow design All designs feature wood-pattern finishes and are available in single-leaf, double-leaf, or sidelight options. You can explore many design combinations using the GIESTA simulator . It lets you mix and match styles with: 7 color choices Different handles A wide range of accessories This gives you the flexibility to create a door design that suits your style. Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors customisable? Yes, TOSTEM provides customisation options, including colour, single leaf, double leak, sidelight, in swing and out swing options. You can design the doors according to your needs and match your home’s aesthetic and functional needs. How do I maintain TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM steel front doors are low-maintenance due to their dust-resistant and patented TEXGUARD coating. A quick wipe with a damp cloth every two weeks is more than enough to keep them clean and glossy. Avoid abrasive cleaners to preserve the finish. Where can I purchase TOSTEM steel entrance doors in India? You can customise your choice of door with Giesta Simulator on the website and then contact our customer service desk to finalise pricing along with the specifications you want. Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors suitable for Vastu-compliant homes? Yes, TOSTEM steel entrance door designs can be customised to align with Vastu principles, such as using strong, durable materials and vibrant colours like orange or yellow for south or west-facing entrances. Their designs support positive energy flow when installed correctly. What is the warranty on TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM provides a warranty issued by the parent company, covering defects in materials and workmanship. For specific warranty details, contact TOSTEM India at support.lwsindia@lixil.com. Aluminium Façades How much do you charge for facades? Both low-rise and high-rise luxury house facades are available with TOSTEM INDIA . Our aluminium composite facades come in different product and price ranges to accommodate the flexible budget requirements of all property owners. Will I have to spend a lot of money on recoating and touch-ups? The answer is no. Our aluminium fences come with anodized coating, which helps retain the colour of the paint and gives our aluminium composite facades a unique long-lasting lustre and gloss retention. Additionally, the use of patented TEXGUARD coating over the anodized coating protects the surface of the facade against heat, light, and water. This double coating protection retains the colour and gloss finishing of our aluminium fins facades for upto 40 years. Aluminium Interior What is the IN16 series? The IN16 is TOSTEM’s new interior series designed to create seamless transitions, invisible boundaries, and a sense of openness in your home with a minimal and modern sensibility19. How does the IN16 series contribute to a harmonious living space? The IN16 series achieves harmony by connecting spaces through fluid designs, unified forms, and integrated functions, all while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic What are the key design principles of the IN16 series? The key design principles include Japanese precision, minimal and modern sensibility, seamless transitions, and the concealment of hardware for a refined and premium look. Can the IN16 interior series be matched with exterior products? Yes, the IN16 interior series is designed to harmonize effortlessly with TOSTEM’s exterior products, offering unified colors, finishes, and forms for a truly seamless living experience, inside and out. Are there customization options available for the IN16 series? Yes, the IN16 interior series offers customizable lattice patterns, allowing homeowners to tailor the design to match their space and extend design continuity to exterior windows and doors. What types of doors are available in the IN16 series? The IN16 series includes hanging doors and swing doors, both featuring minimal design, refined profiles, and options for soft-close mechanisms and various handle selections. Fixed dividers are also part of the series. What handle options are available for the doors in the IN16 series? Both hanging and swing doors offer two distinctive handle options designed to suit different lifestyles and aesthetics while maintaining a unified design language. The floating handle, a compact and minimalist option, blends effortlessly with the door’s sleek profile. The divider handle extends from floor to ceiling, creating a strong vertical accent. Both handles share the same size proportions, color palette, and material finish, ensuring seamless visual harmony. Airflow System What makes the Tostem Airflow System more effective than simply opening windows? The Tostem Airflow System provides controlled and consistent airflow throughout your home. Strategically placed vents and integrated airflow panels maximize cross-ventilation, even in low wind conditions. Unlike open windows, it also offers insect protection and enhanced security. How do I maintain windows and doors that incorporate the Airflow System? Maintaining your Tostem Airflow System is easy, thanks to the protective layer of our patented Texguard Technology. Simply wipe the components with a damp cloth every two weeks. The insect mesh screens in the ventilation door are removable and washable for easy cleaning and optimal airflow. Avoid abrasive cleaners, as these may damage the finish. What are the benefits of the Tostem Airflow System? The Tostem Airflow System offers numerous benefits: improved indoor air quality, reduced reliance on air conditioning (leading to lower energy bills), a cooler, more comfortable living environment, protection from insects, enhanced security, seamless integration with other Tostem products, and reduced humidity and mold growth. Does the Tostem Airflow System have sufficient security measures? Safety and security are top priorities in Tostem’s design process. The Airflow System not only provides ventilation but also protects against insects and burglaries. It features secure anti-theft locks that are easy to operate with Tostem’s locking system, improving security whether you’re home or away. What design options are available for the Tostem Airflow System? The Tostem Airflow System includes various options: GIESTA Airflow (steel wood-pattern door with integrated ventilation), Airflow Door (ventilation door with a sliding window for adjustable ventilation), and Airflow Slot (ventilation slot with a flap, compatible with various Tostem window designs). You can also choose from various colors, finishes, and sizes for vents, slots, and doors to ensure a cohesive look. How effective is the Tostem Airflow System in terms of energy efficiency? The Tostem Airflow System is very effective at enhancing energy efficiency. By utilizing natural ventilation, it reduces your reliance on air conditioning and fans, resulting in lower electricity bills and a smaller carbon footprint. While the exact savings depend on individual home factors, many homeowners experience noticeable reductions in energy costs. Aluminium Awning Windows How much does an awning window cost? Custom awning window prices are available in your target price range with TOSTEM. When shopping for a window, the cost can vary based on several factors such as: The company’s reputation : The more recognised the window manufacturing company , the higher the aluminium awning window prices will be. Despite our spot-on reputation in the international market, our external awning windows are reasonably priced for easy access. The quality standards : The manufacturing standards play a critical role in dictating the custom awning window prices. We follow competitive ASTM, BIS, and JIS quality assurance standards to ensure guaranteed quality across all our external awning windows. Customisations requested : Based on your unique customisation requirements, the aluminium awning window prices may vary. For example, a top hung awning window with an insect screen will cost more than a custom awning window without an insect screen. Similarly, double hung windows will cost you more than single hung windows. Are top hung awning windows good for ventilation? Yes, top hung awning windows are perfect for ventilation. Our window opens outward from the bottom, allowing ample sunlight and fresh breeze to pass into your rooms without obstruction. Purchase from us to access our perfectly designed aluminium window for ventilation. What is the difference between awning and casement windows? Some of the notable difference between awning and casement windows are as follows: Casement windows are hinged at the sides and swing open. On the other hand, awning windows are hinged at the top and open outward from the bottom side. Casement windows are made for openings where the height is greater than the width. On the contrary, awning windows are made for openings where the width is greater than the height. Casement windows are commonly available in 1-5 lite configurations. On the other hand, awning windows are generally available in 1, 2, or 3 lite configurations. The difference between awning and casement windows as illustrated in the above-mentioned points give you an idea on the technical specificities of both window designs. Choose one or a combination of both windows to revolutionise your homes. We recommend an awning type window design for homeowners who live in snowy or heavy rainfall areas as the design architecture of both small and large awning windows prevent water or snow from entering your homes. Even small awning windows fit perfectly with smaller homes with tiny openings. Aluminium Casement Doors What are aluminium casement doors, and how do they differ from other door types? Aluminium casement doors are simply hinged doors that open inwards and outwards. These doors are commonly made of large glass panels, allowing for great ventilation and aesthetics. These doors offer a wider opening, unlike sliding or bi-fold doors. These types of doors are best suited for wardrobes, kitchens, and bathrooms because of their durable aluminium frames and versatile swing design. Why should I choose TOSTEM aluminium casement doors for my home? TOSTEM aluminium casement doors are created with Japanese technology. TOSTEM casement doors come with anodised TEXGUARD coating, which offers a very low-wear-and-tear life cycle, 10 times the strength of comparable UPVC doors, and are built with environmentally friendly products. TOSTEM INDIA manufactures the best premium quality aluminium tilt and slide windows in India and stands as an undisputed leader in the doors and windows manufacturing industry. Aluminium Ventilation Doors What is the cost of an Aluminium Ventilation Door? The aluminium ventilation door prices can vary based on many factors such as: Quality standards : The aluminium ventilation door prices can vary depending on the quality standards maintained in the manufacturing process. Despite our compliance with international manufacturing standards such as the ASTM, BIS, and JIS, we continue to price our aluminium ventilation door designs at pocket-friendly prices to make our doors affordable. Customisation requirements : Based on your unique customisation requirements, the aluminium ventilation door prices can vary. For example, opting for costly door accessories or choosing a premium door finish can cost you considerably more than a default ventilation door. Cost per sq ft : Based on the cost of aluminium ventilation doors per sq ft, the overall price of the product can go up and down. Different manufacturers may quote a different price for every square ft. If you opt for a significantly larger door, the cost will automatically be more. Manufacturing company’s reputation : The more recognised the door manufacturing company, the more expensive its doors would be. Despite being a leading door manufacturer with a spot-on reputation in the housing industry, all our aluminium doors, including our aluminium custom ventilation doors, are priced reasonably for easy accessibility. Aluminium Vertical Sliding Windows What is the cost of Aluminium Vertical Sliding Windows? Vertical sliding window prices can easily vary from company to company based on several factors such as: The quality standards: The manufacturing standards play a big factor. At TOSTEM , we follow competitive ASTM (American standards for testing and materials) and JIS (Japanese industrial standards) quality assurance standards to ensure guaranteed quality across all our products. Customisations requested: Based on your unique window customisation requirements, an aluminium sliding window’s cost can vary. The company’s reputation: The more recognised the window manufacturing company, the higher the aluminium vertical sliding window prices will be. Per square feet cost: The cost of aluminium vertical sliding windows per sq ft will determine how budget-friendly or costly a window will be. We consciously price the per square feet window cost to make our vertical sliding windows accessible for all. How do you install an aluminium vertical sliding window? TOSTEM vertical sliding windows are easy to install. Here’s what you need to know: Our vertical sliding glass windows are pre-engineered and come home delivered in a box, making self-paced window installation a possibility with us. The window parts of our vertical sliding glass windows are easy to install and assemble. Post-purchase, we will send over an engineer with the installation team to fit these windows in your home. Assembly and installation take approximately 3-4 hours. Fixed Divider What kind of spaces are Fixed Dividers best suited for? They’re ideal for creating defined zones in open layouts—such as separating living and dining areas, study corners, or office cabins—while maintaining openness and natural light. How strong is the Fixed Divider frame? Built with high-quality aluminum and tested to global standards, the frame offers excellent strength without adding bulk. Can I match the finish of the divider with my doors and windows? Yes. The Fixed Divider is part of the IN16 Interior Series, allowing perfect color and finish coordination with doors and other fixtures. Will it block light or make my interiors feel smaller? Not at all. Its slim profiles are designed to allow maximum visibility and light flow, so your space feels open and connected. What finishes can I choose from? Five elegant finishes are available—Natural White, Shine Gray, Autumn Brown, Dusk Gray, and Natural Black—crafted to suit modern and traditional interiors alike. Is the divider easy to maintain? Yes. Thanks to TEXGUARD coating, it resists stains, fading, and scratches, requiring only minimal cleaning. Can it be customized for my space? Absolutely. With flexible height (up to 3500mm) and width (up to 2400mm), the divider can be tailored to suit different layouts and requirements. GIESTA Entrance Doors What should I look for when buying an Entrance Door? While buying metallic finish entrance doors for your home, look for the below-mentioned qualities: Durability : Since you are looking for a main entrance door, look for durable steel-made entrance doors that can withstand blunt forces and potential break-ins. Design Options : Versatility in design and colour combination helps customers like you buy a product that best represents their unique style and aesthetic requirements. Customisation Options : Look for metallic finish entrance doors that can accommodate your unique customisations in terms of colour, design, and door accessories. Quality Standards : Verify the maintenance of appropriate industry standards with the manufacturer to confirm the quality of wood pattern entrance doors you are hoping to purchase. How much does a GIESTA entrance door cost at TOSTEM? We are the best GIESTA door manufacturers in India and our GIESTA Entrance Door prices are consciously decided to ensure that our doors are affordable and accessible to all homeowners. The pull and Push bar handle for Entrance Doors are designed for ease of operation and the multi-lock systems & triple sickle-shaped latches reinforce home security. Get in touch with us at tostemsales.lws@lixil.com to get a quote on our top-shelf Giesta Entrance Doors. A member of our team will get in touch with you at your earliest convenience and give you a guided overview of our unique housing products. Are TOSTEM Giesta doors burglar-proof? TOSTEM Giesta doors feature a triple sickle-shaped latch system, Giesta double lock mechanism, concealed hinges, and steel-reinforced panels — making them highly resistant to forced entry and break-ins. The removable thumb-turn key head adds an extra layer of anti-burglar protection. What type of lock system does the TOSTEM Giesta door use? Giesta doors use a double lock system with triple sickle-shaped latches, a cylinder lock with resin-coated steel keys, and an optional digital lock. The inside thumb-turn is removable to prevent accidental or forced unlocking. Is the TOSTEM Giesta door made of wood or steel? Giesta doors are made of durable steel panels but are finished with a premium wood-grain pattern using TEXGUARD coating, giving them the aesthetic of a wooden door with the strength and termite-resistance of steel. How long do TOSTEM Giesta entrance doors last? TOSTEM Giesta doors are built to last, with TEXGUARD patented coating providing gloss and lustre retention for up to 40 years. The steel construction ensures the door does not warp, rust, or deform over time. Are TOSTEM Giesta doors termite-proof and weather-resistant? Yes. The wrapped steel panels with an inbuilt insulating structure prevent termite infestation and protect against heat transmission, humidity, and fluctuating weather – making them ideal for Indian climatic conditions. Can I customise my TOSTEM Giesta door with sidelights and glass panels? Yes. Giesta doors can be customised with single or double sidelights, glass design elements, and a choice of in-swing or out-swing configurations to match your home’s architecture and aesthetic preferences. What is the TOSTEM Giesta door simulator? The TOSTEM Giesta Door Simulator is an online tool available at tostemindia.com that lets you virtually mix and match door designs, colours, handles, and sidelight options before purchasing, so you can visualise exactly how your entrance door will look at home. How much does a TOSTEM Giesta entrance door cost in India? TOSTEM Giesta door prices vary based on design, colour, handle type, and add-ons like sidelights or digital locks. For an accurate quote tailored to your requirements, contact TOSTEM at tostemsales.lws@lixil.com or use the Giesta Simulator on the website to finalise your specifications. How do I maintain a TOSTEM Giesta steel door? Giesta doors require minimal maintenance due to their dust-resistant TEXGUARD coating. Simply wipe the surface with a damp cloth every two weeks. Avoid abrasive cleaners to preserve the finish and long-lasting lustre. How many designs and colours are available in the Giesta door collection? The TOSTEM Giesta door collection offers 10 designs and 7 colours, resulting in over 70 possible colour-design combinations. The range includes high-quality wood grain patterns and metallic finishes, suitable for main entrance doors and condominiums. Giesta Ventilation Doors How much do GIESTA Ventilation Doors cost at TOSTEM? Our Giesta Ventilation Door prices are consciously decided to ensure greater affordability and accessibility for all homeowners. Based on the design, colour, and ventilation window feature you choose, the cost of each product might slightly vary from each other. Get in touch with us at support.lwsindia@lixil.com to get a quote on our top-shelf Giesta Ventilation Doors. A member of our team will get in touch with you at your earliest convenience and give you a guided overview of all our unique Giesta ventilation door products. What is the USP of the GIESTA Ventilation Doors at TOSTEM? Here are some of the top reasons why our Giesta Ventilation Doors stand out: Our Giesta Ventilation Doors are ideal for use as the main entrance door because it is very strongly built, making these doors ideal for avoiding forced break-ins and burglary. The biggest USP of our Giesta Ventilation Doors is that it comes with an attached airflow window that you can easily open and close. It allows free flow of air into your rooms, thus removing foul smells and humidity and keeping your homes fresh and cool. This is a distinguishing feature unlike any other. The use of multi-lock systems is unique to our Wood Pattern Giesta Ventilation Doors. It helps improve the security of the door. The inside key head can be easily removed to prevent the door from unlocking in case of a burglary attempt. In addition to its durability, the look and aesthetic of our Giesta Ventilation Doors is another unique USP that distinguishes it from other main entrance doors. The wood finishing gives our doors a royal ensemble, whereas the metal component keeps them highly sturdy & durable. Hanging Door What is the Hanging Door in the IN16 series? It is a sophisticated, multi-panel, premium sliding door system designed to create fluid, open interiors with slim frames, concealed hardware, and refined design. What handle options are available? Two options: Floating Handle – Compact and minimalist. Divider Handle – A strong vertical accent, extending floor to ceiling. Both share the same size, colour palette, and finish. Can the Hanging Door be customized? Yes. Homeowners can choose from multiple panel layouts, glazing options (5–10 mm), lattice patterns, and finishes. Does it match other TOSTEM products? Yes. The Hanging Door is part of the IN16 Interior Series, designed to match exterior systems with unified forms, finishes, and colours. How does it enhance living environments? By blending minimal design, silent operation, and versatile configurations to create fluid, open spaces that feel unified and elegant. What makes its design stand out? The Invisible hardware, flush glazing, and slim profiles result in a clean, seamless aesthetic that elevates functional design. Lift and Slide Doors How much do aluminium lift and slide doors cost? Various factors such as these dictate the aluminium lift and slide doors cost : The manufacturing company’s reputation: The more recognised the door manufacturing company , the more the lift and slide patio doors cost will be. Quality Standards: The quality standards upheld in the manufacturing process can increase the lift and slide patio doors cost Customisation Requirements: Based on your unique door customisation requests, your lift and slide doors cost can go up. Based on the lift and slide doors cost per sq ft, a door’s overall cost can exceed your budget. So, consider the cost per sq ft before making a purchase. Get in touch with us at tostemsales.lws@lixil.com to get a quote on our aluminium lift and slide door designs. We would like to hear from you. What’s the difference between a Lift and Slide Door and Sliding Door? A lift and slide door is a type of sliding door . It has a similar operating mechanism with the exception that it can be lifted off its tracks. A lift and slide doors use special hardware to allow the panels to lift off their track and help the user glide open and close the door. Swing Door What makes TOSTEM Swing Doors better than regular wooden doors? TOSTEM Swing Doors are built with precision-engineered aluminum and a patented TEXGUARD coating, ensuring durability, scratch resistance, and long-lasting color, far superior to wooden doors that warp, fade, or need frequent polishing. Can I choose different finishes or colors for my interiors? Yes. Swing Doors come in multiple finishes designed to match modern interiors. The TEXGUARD coating keeps the surface looking new for years, no matter which color you select. Do Swing Doors require a lot of maintenance? Not at all. A simple wipe with a damp cloth is enough to keep them looking clean and polished. Unlike wooden or steel doors, they don’t require repainting or special treatments. Are they safe for homes with children and elderly people? Yes. The soft-close mechanism prevents harsh slamming and ensures smoother, safer operation. The rail-free option also reduces tripping hazards, making them family-friendly. Can Swing Doors be installed in compact spaces? Absolutely. Designed with slim profiles and flexible opening directions, Swing Doors fit beautifully in bedrooms, studies, and living spaces, even where space is limited. Will these doors last in humid or high-temperature conditions? Yes. Tested against ASTM and JIS standards, Swing Doors are resistant to moisture, heat, and UV exposure, making them ideal for Indian conditions. Ventilation Slots What is the difference between a regular window and one with a ventilation slot? A ventilation slot can be referred to as a window with a small and more controlled opening for ventilation. With TOSTEM INDIA’s high-quality narrow mesh area and rubber gaskets, you also keep insects, dust, and noise at a minimum. Will installing a ventilation slot mess with the aesthetics of the room? Not at all! TOSTEM INDIA integrates the slot carefully into the window frame, ensuring that nothing disrupts that modern appearance. You still enjoy large glass panes and slim sightlines, ensuring a clean and stylish look in any room. Is it possible to add a ventilation slot to an existing aluminium window? It depends on your current frame’s design. In many cases, it is always easier to purchase a pre-engineered window. TOSTEM India ensures to offer you an easy way when it comes to installation with our “Window in a box” feature so that the process can become completely hassle free! Is the ventilation slot hard to clean? Not really. The mesh or screen can usually be taken out for washing, and the coated aluminium surface is easy to wipe down. This design makes it simple to keep the slot clear of trapped dirt, ensuring better airflow over time. Does the ventilation slot offer sound insulation? Yes. The rubber gaskets and perfect mesh helps reduce noise infiltration. Although it won’t match the quietness of a window that is fully closed, you still enjoy a more peaceful environment than you would if the entire window were open. an industrially manufactured product made entirely of metal, its appearance makes it look as if it has been made from wood using traditional methods. The door with lattice-like structure looks sophisticated but has been designed to be discreet so that it can adapt with subtlety to contemporary architecture. The door has a very high level of heat insulation and thus helps to save energy, which is particularly valuable in regions with large variations in temperature. Red Dot Award 2021 25 Mar 2021 TOSTEM LW is a window developed to realize a bright and comfortable living for the residents. In addition to high heat insulation performance, it has a design and structure that allows you to feel the maximum connection with the outside by the window. With a frame-in design in which all frames on the top, bottom, left, and right cannot be seen from inside the room even when opened or closed, a design with a built-in lock handle in the vertical frame. iF Design Award 2021 11 Mar 2021 TOSTEM “LW” window was developed to support home users to realize a bright, pleasant and fulfilling home environment. on the planet dreams of a better home. LIXIL makes that possible with pioneering housing and water products. A better home is made up of surprisingly simple things – baths to escape in after a long day, kitchens that unleash creativity, toilets that provide cleanliness and comfort, aluminium doors and aluminium windows that connect you with the world outside, and interiors and exteriors that bring spaces to life. LIXIL makes products that improve how we live, from shower toilets to baths, kitchen systems, windows, doors, building exteriors and interior furnishings. Combined with our housing and building-related services, we are today meeting the demand for better homes in markets worldwide. We are proud that our products touch the lives of more than a billion people every day but believe we have the potential to do so much more. Our corporate philosophy defines what we set out to do in the world. LIXIL’s superior products and services contribute to improving people’s comfort and lifestyles. At LIXIL, our corporate purpose is to make better homes a reality for everyone, everywhere. We cater to the wide range of lifestyles and needs of people around the world through products that pair cutting-edge technology with meaningful designs, and through industry-leading brands. LIXIL makes better homes a reality for everyone, everywhere. LIXIL CORPORATION – BUSINESS OVERVIEW In December 2020, former holding company LIXIL Group Corporation has completed its merger with and adopted the name of its 100% subsidiary, LIXIL Corporation. By becoming a simplified operating company, LIXIL will improve its management efficiency, reduce duplication of resources and improve corporate governance, while building an entrepreneurial organization. In 2011, LIXIL Group was named with the merger of five of Japan’s most successful building materials and housing companies, LIXIL Group Corporation draws on Japanese heritage to create world-leading technologies and innovate to make high quality products that transform homes. LIXIL Group Corporation has approximately 270 subsidiaries and affiliates operating in more than 150 countries. The group engages in a broad spectrum of housing and building-related businesses, ranging from manufacture and sales of housing and building products, materials and equipment, to the operation of home centers and homebuilding franchise chains, as well as a variety of housing related services. LIXIL Group Corporation makes things that matter to all sorts of different people, to the many communities we are part of, and to sustainably support the world we live in. While each of our brands has its own unique personality and strengths, together they provide us with an unmatched offering and ability to meet the full scope of consumer preferences and needs. Our approach comes to life through our portfolio of the industry’s most trusted brands, including INAX , GROHE , American Standard , and TOSTEM . With around 60,000 colleagues in more than 150 countries, we are proud to make products that touch the lives of more than a billion people every day. But the LIXIL difference isn’t what we do or where we do it, it is how we do it: We combine meaningful design, an entrepreneurial spirit, a dedication to improving accessibility for all, and responsible business growth to make things that matter – to people, to communities, and to the world we live in. We are proud that our products touch the lives of more than a billion people every day but believe we have the potential to do so much more. Are your aluminium windows customisable? Yes, you can customise the size, colour, finish, and glass type. Whether you prefer a minimalist design or a bold statement, TOSTEM India engineers windows that perfectly complement your space. How do I maintain aluminium windows? Regular cleaning is the simplest way to maintain aluminium windows. Thanks to the protective TEXGUARD coating, there’s no need for polishing or repainting, keeping your windows looking new with minimal effort for up to 40 years. Why choose Tostem India for aluminium windows? TOSTEM India offers smart, reliable solutions for your home with the help of Japanese engineering and pre-designed window systems. Our windows come with advanced coatings, strong anodised frames, and built-in sound insulation. front doors designed to enhance the look and security of contemporary homes. Available in exquisite patterns and premium colours, these doors combine elegance with superior strength and versatility. Engineered with advanced Japanese technology, our weatherproof main-entrance steel doors deliver exceptional durability, robust security, and smooth operation, making them the preferred choice for both residential and commercial entryways. Product Features TOSTEM main entrance steel door designs come with user-friendly handles and high security lock systems. The panels of these steel entrance doors are made up of wrapped panels with insulating material inside, resulting in protection against surrounding weather conditions and termite infestations. Modern features with 70+ designs Tested as per Global Standards Anti-rust epoxy coating Factory Made, Engineered Product Enquire Now Download Brochure Download Test Report Human Friendly Design Designed for ergonomics and aesthetics Weather Performance Tested for wind, water, heat, and noise resistance Security Better security and durability than wooden doors Steel Entrance Doors Design: Image Gallery prev next Key Features and Benefits of TOSTEM Steel Entrance Doors Japanese Innovation Entry Steel Door Design: Nothing speaks ‘innovation’ better and louder than TOSTEM’s front steel doors. Our entrance steel door designs are pre-structured and pre-designed according to the best global standards, making premium quality and performance a guarantee. Safety features: Featuring steel panels, concealed hinges, and locking systems such as hook locks, digital handles, and triple sickle-shaped latches, our highly reliable stainless steel entrance door designs stand as a bedrock of advanced safety & security that is hard to match. Anti-Pinch: Our exquisite door designs feature a smart design to prevent finger pinching. The use of rubber-made EPDM gaskets in our door designs adds a layered protection to our doors. The result: Enhanced safety and accident-free doors at your disposal. Versatile Door Handles: TOSTEM INDIA’s come with ergonomically designed door handles. Tech-savvy homeowners can opt for our digital door handles, while conventional homeowners looking for simple door accessories can opt for our traditional door handles. Strong & Resilient: The steel component of our entrance steel door design features that much-needed strength to protect you from intruders and weather fluctuations. Resistance to force, deformity, and weight exertions is another USP of our steel exterior doors. Door Accessories: What makes our steel main doors an absolute must-have for your home is the innovative door accessories that come with them. Our door closers, door guards, digital locks, cylinder locks & keys, door scoops, and many more accessories are available in steel components. Simple & Minimalistic: Our steel front doors are a perfect combination of simple designs and minimalist charm. Available in seven vibrant colours, our modern steel front doors are the ideal housing solution for residential spaces. Modern But Traditional: Our entrance steel door design keeps the charm of traditional doors while adding a modern touch. It includes an in-built airflow vent, which is an innovative feature that lets fresh air in without needing a second mesh door. This way, you get the look of a classic door with the function of a modern one, all in a single smart steel door solution. Glass With Style: Our stainless steel entrance doors feature glass design elements that give it a fresh tinge of unmatched elegance that is hard to ignore. Available in seven colours, our steel doors will impress and win the admiration of your home visitors, one visitor at a time! Luxury Entrance Door Designs: Our beautiful entrance steel door design are engineered with perfection and designed to give your home a look of pure opulence. From door accessories to immaculate door handles to glass design elements - every door component is a work of art. What should I look for when buying steel doors? While buying beautiful steel doors for your home, look for the below-mentioned qualities: Durability of the steel doors: Since it is the main entry door, it has to be performance efficient to withstand blunt forces and potential break-ins. Design options: If you want the ideal main entrance steel door design for your home, choose ones that come with versatile designs. Customisation options: Look for steel front doors that can accommodate unique customizations. Quality standards: See if the industry standards are maintained by the manufacturer while manufacturing your preferred steel front doors for homes. How much does an entrance door cost? The steel entrance door prices can vary from company to company based on many factors such as: The more recognised the company, the costlier their main door will be. The quality standards upheld in the manufacturing process. A steel entry door price can also vary based on the type of customisations required. If a home entrance door you are purchasing is manufactured within your home country, it will be cheaper. If it is imported from other countries, an steel entry door price can be substantially higher in comparison. Read More What makes TOSTEM your go-to Brand for Steel Entrance Doors 1 Cutting-Edge Japanese Technology TOSTEM is the leading Japanese brand for global housing and building materials. Engineered with sophisticated Japanese technology, our home entrance steel doors enjoy the sheer technological finesse of the highest standards. 2 Quality Assurance & Testing We uphold competitive ASTM (American standards for testing and materials) and JIS (Japanese industrial standards) quality assurance standards. The result: impeccable entrance steel door designs with industry-tested performance and unmatched resilience. 3 Surface & Colour Perfection All TOSTEM products are safeguarded with anodised coating to give our main entrance steel door design that dreamy, long-lasting lustre. The use of a patented TEXGUARD system preserves the colouring of our house entrance doors and protects them from heat, light, and water. 4 On-Time Delivery Purchasing from our exquisite collection of home entrance steel door designs means signing up for a hassle-free purchasing experience. Delivering and installing our impeccable luxury entrance doors at the agreed turnaround time is a guarantee when you buy from us. 5 Flexible Door Price Our entrance steel doors collection comes in a varying price range. Designed with the idea of providing affordable housing solutions, TOSTEM’s house entrance steel door designs can accommodate different budget requirements. Frequently Asked Questions What makes TOSTEM steel entrance doors different from other brands? TOSTEM steel entrance doors are made using smart Japanese technology. They have strong steel panels on the outside and insulation inside, which makes them very durable, weatherproof, and safe from termites. The doors have a special TEXGUARD coating that keeps them shiny for a long time and makes them easy to clean. They are made with high-quality standards (ASTM and JIS certified). What makes them special? They have: Triple safety locks shaped like a sickle Digital locking system Built-in air vents to let fresh air in Anti-pinch design for extra safety Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors energy-efficient? Yes, TOSTEM steel main doors help keep your home cool in summer and warm in winter. Thanks to the insulated steel layers, they stop outside heat or cold from getting in. This helps lower electricity bills and makes them a great choice for homes that want to save energy. How durable are TOSTEM steel entrance doors? With optimum care, TOSTEM steel entrance doors can last for years. Their strong construction, corrosion-resistant materials, and anodised TEXGUARD coating ensure long-term performance, even in harsh weather conditions like rain, heat, and humidity. What safety features do TOSTEM steel entrance doors offer? TOSTEM doors are designed with advanced safety features, including steel panels, concealed hinges, hook locks, digital handles, and triple sickle-shaped latches. The Giesta double lock system and removable thumb-turn enhance security, protecting against break-ins and blunt forces. Furthermore, their inbuilt airflow system with grill and mesh, offers added security and a channel for ventilation at the same time. Can TOSTEM steel entrance doors withstand extreme weather conditions? Yes, TOSTEM steel main doors are tested to global standards (ASTM and JIS) and engineered to resist harsh weather, including heavy rain, heat, and humidity. The insulated structure and TEXGUARD coating ensure resilience and prevent heat transmission. What design options are available for TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM steel entrance doors come under the GIESTA series, which offers four design sub-series: P Series – Simple design D Series – Modern design G Series – Glass design A Series – Airflow design All designs feature wood-pattern finishes and are available in single-leaf, double-leaf, or sidelight options. You can explore many design combinations using the GIESTA simulator . It lets you mix and match styles with: 7 color choices Different handles A wide range of accessories This gives you the flexibility to create a door design that suits your style. Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors customisable? Yes, TOSTEM provides customisation options, including colour, single leaf, double leak, sidelight, in swing and out swing options. You can design the doors according to your needs and match your home’s aesthetic and functional needs. How do I maintain TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM steel front doors are low-maintenance due to their dust-resistant and patented TEXGUARD coating. A quick wipe with a damp cloth every two weeks is more than enough to keep them clean and glossy. Avoid abrasive cleaners to preserve the finish. Where can I purchase TOSTEM steel entrance doors in India? You can customise your choice of door with Giesta Simulator on the website and then contact our customer service desk to finalise pricing along with the specifications you want. Are TOSTEM steel entrance doors suitable for Vastu-compliant homes? Yes, TOSTEM steel entrance door designs can be customised to align with Vastu principles, such as using strong, durable materials and vibrant colours like orange or yellow for south or west-facing entrances. Their designs support positive energy flow when installed correctly. What is the warranty on TOSTEM steel entrance doors? TOSTEM provides a warranty issued by the parent company, covering defects in materials and workmanship. For specific warranty details, contact TOSTEM India at support.lwsindia@lixil.com.
